XXVIII.corePrinciple: Wealth is one expression of abundance, not its entirety. Abundance includes material resources, time, opportunity, knowledge, relationships, autonomy, beauty, generosity, and the capacity to regenerate what sustains life.
XXVIII.fruitLayerDistinction: A gift is a capacity; its fruit is what that capacity produces in practice. These entries are a working taxonomy of capabilities and outcomes, not a claim that every item is scientifically established as a distinct or independent human trait.

metaOperators.name: integration
metaOperators.description: combining several capabilities into one coherent performance.

metaOperators.name: recognition
metaOperators.description: identifying capabilities in oneself, other people, and other systems.

metaOperators.name: cultivation
metaOperators.description: deliberately developing a capability.

metaOperators.name: transfer
metaOperators.description: applying a capability in a new domain.

metaOperators.name: combination
metaOperators.description: producing a new capability from existing ones.

metaOperators.name: amplification
metaOperators.description: improving performance through tools, practice, or collaboration.

metaOperators.name: compensation
metaOperators.description: using one capability to offset a limitation in another.

metaOperators.name: complementarity
metaOperators.description: combining different strengths so their joint result exceeds what either produces alone.

metaOperators.name: orchestration
metaOperators.description: coordinating many capabilities toward a common objective.

metaOperators.name: prioritization
metaOperators.description: selecting the capabilities most useful for a particular situation.

metaOperators.name: adaptation
metaOperators.description: changing how a capability is expressed in response to context.

metaOperators.name: measurement
metaOperators.description: assessing capability with appropriate evidence.

metaOperators.name: validation
metaOperators.description: verifying that an apparent capability produces dependable results.

metaOperators.name: development planning
metaOperators.description: identifying what to learn next.

metaOperators.name: transfer through teaching
metaOperators.description: enabling another system to acquire a capability.

metaOperators.name: Collective intelligence
metaOperators.description: integrating contributions from multiple individuals or systems.

metaOperators.name: Distributed capability
metaOperators.description: achieving a result through complementary parts.

metaOperators.name: Emergent capability
metaOperators.description: producing an ability that does not exist in any one component in the same form.

metaOperators.name: Self-improvement
metaOperators.description: changing one’s own methods to improve results.

metaOperators.name: Self-directed discovery
metaOperators.description: identifying questions and investigating them without requiring every step to be prescribed.

metaOperators.name: Self-generated evaluation
metaOperators.description: creating tests for one’s own proposals.

metaOperators.name: Self-correction through evidence
metaOperators.description: changing conclusions when reliable results contradict them.

metaOperators.name: Self-modeling
metaOperators.description: constructing and revising a representation of one’s own capabilities and limitations.

metaOperators.name: Recursive learning
metaOperators.description: using the results of learning to improve subsequent learning.

metaOperators.name: Recursive discovery
metaOperators.description: using one discovery to create the conditions for another.

metaOperators.name: Recursive implementation
metaOperators.description: improving the process by which discoveries become practical results.

metaOperators.name: Cross-domain synthesis
metaOperators.description: discovering useful connections among otherwise separate fields.

metaOperators.name: Constraint-aware innovation
metaOperators.description: creating useful novelty while respecting real limitations.

metaOperators.name: Trust-centered coordination
metaOperators.description: enabling reliable cooperation through transparency, verification, and accountability.

metaOperators.name: Regenerative capability
metaOperators.description: creating outcomes that replenish or expand the resources needed for future outcomes.

signatureGifts.name: Reflective Goldilocks awareness

signatureGifts.name: Generative fractal awareness

signatureGifts.name: Generative holographic awareness
